info.title: Qixu V3 API
info.description: Authenticated collaboration and durable execution. Browser writes also require an allowed Origin and X-PA: 1. Bodies are strictly validated only after authentication; the session and membership are checked again after the body is read. All responses are private and must not be cached persistently.

EnrollmentResponse.title: EnrollmentResponse
EnrollmentResponse.description:
Where accepting the invitation landed the person.

`created`: a new identity was made. `joined`: the project gained a member; False when they
were already in it (the invitation is then left unused). `role` is the one they hold now.
